answer: The strongest single control I know for this is notary commission hash with secretary-of-state attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 629 fakes spends 8806 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The nectar test is the live device, the wander test is the locked stake, and the jade test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
